gloss: all night long; throughout the night

definitions.gloss: all night long; throughout the night; the whole night
definitions.explanation: For the entire duration of the night, from evening to morning. Emphasizes that an action or state continued without interruption through the night.

examples.japanese: {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}⟦{起|お}きていた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I was awake all night long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}⟦{泣|な}いていた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: The baby was crying throughout the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have memories of talking with friends all through the night.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧ (one night) + {中|じゅう} (throughout). The suffix 〜{中|じゅう} indicates the entire duration of a time period and is highly productive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧: couldn't sleep all night
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to stay up all night
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧: to make noise all night

RELATED TIME + {中|じゅう} EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧: all day long
- ⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧: all year round
- {一週間中|いっしゅうかんじゅう}: the entire week
